originalIntent: Euro NCAP AEB Car-to-Car Front Turn-Across-Path / cut-in family and UN R157 ALKS cut-in scenario (a vehicle entering the ego lane at a lateral distance that leaves <2 s to collision). A cut-in that leaves the ego untouched at >3 s TTC is a lane change happening nearby. Bands are pre-registered from published test protocols, not fitted to observed results.
title: Lateral incursion into the ego lane: the cut-in must happen and must force a response
